# Variants

The extension knows seven variant names. The page of each one lists its fields and every mnemonic with its bits. The data comes from the YAML definitions of [nd-microcode-meta](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/nd-microcode-meta); see [Choosing the variant](../choosing-the-variant.md) for how a file gets its variant.

| Variant | Name | Word bits | Mnemonics | Image written by *Assemble* | Ending |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | --- | --- |
| [NORD-10](nd10.md) | `nd10` | 32 | 197 | prom.hex text and 32-bit big-endian .CODE | `.hex` |
| [ND-100](nd100.md) | `nd100` | 64 | 299 | .CODE, 10-byte records | `.CODE` |
| [ND-110](nd110.md) | `nd110` | 64 | 357 | .CODE, 10-byte records | `.CODE` |
| [ND-120](nd120.md) | `nd120` | 64 | 358 | .CODE, 10-byte records | `.CODE` |
| [ND-120 (L)](nd120-dly.md) | `nd120-dly` | 64 | 358 | .CODE, 10-byte records | `.CODE` |
| [ND-500](nd500.md) | `nd500` | 144 | 721 | packed18, 147456 bytes | `.CODE` |
| [ND-5000](nd5000.md) | `nd5000` | 128 | 609 | 16 bytes per word, 262144 bytes | `.DATA` |

`nd120-dly` has the mnemonics of `nd120`; the count is the same.
